atAGlance: Xá xíu is Vietnamese char siu pork, usually with red-edged roast pork, sweet glaze, rice or noodles.
whatItIs: Xá xíu is Vietnamese char siu-style pork, red-brown, sweet-savory, and often sliced into noodles, rice, or bánh mì.
howToEnjoy: Eat it with rice or noodles so the sweet glaze has balance. In bánh mì, pickles and herbs keep the pork from feeling heavy.
howLocalsOrder: Ask for xá xíu when you want the sweet roasted pork topping. Ask for extra pickles in bánh mì or extra rice with a plate.
worthKnowing: This is another Chinese-Vietnamese menu bridge, recognizable by its sweet glaze and red roast-pork look.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần xá xíu.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of Vietnamese-style barbecue pork.
